digest.component_or_area: metrics adapter system (Claude Code transcript backfill)
propositions: An optional isolated adapter must mine local Claude Code session transcripts via deterministic error-signature grep and keyword/regex classification (no LLM call) to reconstruct environment and integration diagnosis history.

Classification rules must route error signatures to exactly five categories (env_setup, dependency, integration, tooling, none) with canonical pattern-to-enum mapping and every emitted record tagged source=backfill_classified, confidence=classified.

The core metrics package (registry.py, __init__.py) must not import the claude_transcripts adapter; the adapter and backfill script are quarantined behind optional backfill and never loaded by the rebar metrics command.

Unit tests must verify deterministic classification of fixture JSONL transcripts containing known error signatures into tagged intervals, clean transcripts yield zero records, and no network/model calls occur.
The backfill_transcripts.py script must be exercised end-to-end over fixture transcript directories and emit labeled classified records conforming to the JSON schema.
